Name: Guest entry via Continue as Guest button
Description: Validates that a guest can enter the app without any sign-in or form fields by tapping the single Continue as Guest CTA on the landing screen.
Preconditions: App is freshly launched on the landing screen showing the Encore logo and tagline.
Test Steps (Steps): Launch the Encore app ~ Landing screen is displayed with the Encore logo, tagline 'Find a seat. See a show.', and a 'Continue as Guest' button
Tap the 'Continue as Guest' button ~ App navigates directly to the Event List screen with no sign-in prompt or form fields shown
Verify the Events header and category filter chips are visible ~ 'Events' heading, 'All' chip (selected), and category chips (Music, Sports, Theater, Classical, Comedy) are displayed
Verify the 'My Bookings' navigation button is visible in the header ~ 'My Bookings' button is present in the top-right area

Name: Event list displays title, category, venue, date and starting price
Description: Validates that each event card in the catalog shows all required fields: title, category badge, venue, date/time, and starting price.
Preconditions: Guest has tapped 'Continue as Guest' and is on the Event List screen.
Test Steps (Steps): Observe the first event card in the list ~ Card displays a category badge (e.g. 'Music'), event title, venue name, date/time, and a 'From $X' price
Scroll through several event cards ~ Every visible card consistently shows all five fields: category, title, venue, date/time, price
Verify no card is missing any of the required fields ~ All cards are fully populated with no blank or placeholder values

Name: Category filter narrows event list to selected category
Description: Validates that tapping a category chip filters the event list to show only events of that category, and tapping 'All' resets the full catalog.
Preconditions: Guest is on the Event List screen with 'All' filter selected.
Test Steps (Steps): Note the total number of events visible in the list ~ All events across all categories are displayed
Tap the 'Music' category filter chip ~ Chip becomes selected; event list updates to show only Music events
Verify every visible event card shows the 'Music' category badge ~ No events from other categories appear in the list
Tap the 'All' filter chip ~ All events are restored; 'All' chip is selected and Music chip is deselected
Repeat filter selection for Sports, Theater, Classical, and Comedy categories ~ Each filter correctly narrows the list to only that category's events

Name: Sold-out events are marked and cannot be selected
Description: Validates that events with no remaining seats display a sold-out indicator and are not tappable to proceed to booking.
Preconditions: Guest is on the Event List screen and at least one sold-out event exists in the catalog.
Test Steps (Steps): Scroll through the event list to locate a sold-out event ~ Sold-out event card displays a 'Sold Out' indicator/badge
Attempt to tap the sold-out event card ~ No navigation occurs; the event cannot be opened for seat selection
Verify available events remain tappable ~ Tapping an available event navigates to its Event Details screen

Name: Event Details screen shows full event information and seating summary
Description: Validates that the Event Details screen displays the full description, venue, date/time, and a seating breakdown showing Standard vs VIP counts and remaining seats.
Preconditions: Guest is on the Event List screen and has tapped an available event card.
Test Steps (Steps): Tap an available event card (e.g. 'Late Night Jazz') ~ Event Details screen opens showing the event title, category badge, venue, and date/time
Verify the 'ABOUT THIS EVENT' section is present ~ Full event description text is displayed
Verify the 'SEATING' section shows Standard seat count, VIP seat count, and remaining availability ~ Seating summary shows numeric counts for Standard seats, VIP seats, and total remaining
Verify the 'Select a Seat' button is present at the bottom ~ Button is visible and tappable
Tap the back/navigate-up button ~ Returns to the Event List screen

Name: Seat map displays seats with correct tier, price and availability state
Description: Validates that the seat selection screen renders a seat map grouped by row, with each seat showing its tier (Standard/VIP), price, and correct availability state (available, booked, selected).
Preconditions: Guest has opened an event's details screen and tapped 'Select a Seat'.
Test Steps (Steps): Observe the seat map on the Seat Selection screen ~ Seats are grouped by row (e.g. Row A), each seat button shows its number and is colour-coded by state
Verify the seat legend is visible ~ Legend shows Standard, VIP, Selected, and Booked states
Verify the 'Select up to 10 seats' instruction is displayed ~ Instruction text is visible below the event title
Verify seat accessibility descriptions include tier, state and price (e.g. 'Seat A1, standard, available, $32') ~ Each seat button has a descriptive label matching its actual tier and price
Verify already-booked seats are not tappable ~ Booked seats cannot be selected

Name: Selecting and deselecting seats updates summary count and total price
Description: Validates that tapping an available seat marks it as selected, updates the seat count summary and running total, and tapping it again deselects it.
Preconditions: Guest is on the Seat Selection screen with at least two available seats visible.
Test Steps (Steps): Tap an available seat (e.g. Seat A1) ~ Seat state changes to 'selected'; summary bar appears showing '1 seat selected' and the seat's price
Tap a second available seat (e.g. Seat A2) ~ Summary updates to '2 seats selected' and total price reflects both seats
Tap the first selected seat again (Seat A1) ~ Seat is deselected; summary updates to '1 seat selected' and total price decreases accordingly
Verify the 'Continue to Discount Code' button is enabled when at least one seat is selected ~ Button is tappable

Name: Maximum 10 seats can be selected in a single booking
Description: Validates that the app enforces the 10-seat limit per booking and prevents selecting an 11th seat.
Preconditions: Guest is on the Seat Selection screen for an event with at least 11 available seats.
Test Steps (Steps): Select 10 available seats one by one ~ Summary shows '10 seats selected' and total price reflects all 10 seats
Attempt to tap an 11th available seat ~ The 11th seat cannot be selected; an error or informational message is shown indicating the 10-seat limit has been reached
Verify the 10 previously selected seats remain selected ~ No previously selected seat is deselected automatically

Name: Proceeding without selecting any seat is blocked
Description: Validates that the Continue button on the Seat Selection screen is disabled or shows an error when no seats have been selected.
Preconditions: Guest is on the Seat Selection screen with no seats selected.
Test Steps (Steps): Observe the Seat Selection screen with no seats selected ~ No summary bar is shown; 'Continue to Discount Code' button is disabled or not actionable
Attempt to tap the 'Continue to Discount Code' button ~ Navigation to the Discount Code screen does not occur; user remains on Seat Selection

Name: SAVE10 applies 10% discount to Standard seats only
Description: Validates that the SAVE10 code discounts Standard-tier seats by 10% and does not discount VIP-tier seats in the same order.
Preconditions: Guest has selected at least one Standard seat and one VIP seat and is on the Discount Code screen.
Test Steps (Steps): Note the subtotal shown on the Discount Code screen ~ Subtotal reflects the full price of all selected seats
Enter 'SAVE10' in the discount code input field ~ Field is populated with the code
Tap the 'Apply' button ~ Discount is applied; input and Apply button are replaced by a discount-applied label with a 'Remove' option
Tap 'Continue to Payment' ~ Payment screen opens
Verify each Standard seat line item shows a 10% reduced price ~ Standard seat prices are reduced by 10%
Verify each VIP seat line item shows the original full price ~ VIP seat prices are unchanged
Verify the discount row shows the correct discount amount and the total reflects the discounted Standard seats ~ Discount row and total are mathematically correct

Name: FIRST20 applies 20% discount on first booking only
Description: Validates that FIRST20 gives 20% off any seat on the guest's first booking in a session, and is rejected on any subsequent booking.
Preconditions: Guest has not yet completed any booking in the current session. Guest has selected seats and is on the Discount Code screen.
Test Steps (Steps): Enter 'FIRST20' in the discount code input and tap Apply ~ Code is accepted; discount-applied label is shown
Proceed through Payment and complete the first booking ~ Booking confirmation is shown with 20% discount applied to all seats
Return to Events, select seats for a second event, and navigate to the Discount Code screen ~ Discount Code screen is displayed
Enter 'FIRST20' and tap Apply ~ Code is rejected with an inline error message indicating the code is no longer valid
Verify the guest can still proceed to payment without the code ~ 'Continue to Payment' button remains available

Name: WELCOME15 applies 15% discount from second booking onward, valid once
Description: Validates that WELCOME15 is invalid on the first booking, applies 15% off any seat on the second booking, and becomes invalid again after one successful use.
Preconditions: Guest has completed exactly one booking in the current session and is on the Discount Code screen for a second booking.
Test Steps (Steps): On the first booking's Discount Code screen, enter 'WELCOME15' and tap Apply ~ Code is rejected with an error indicating it is not valid on the first booking
Complete the first booking without the code ~ First booking is confirmed
Select seats for a second event and navigate to the Discount Code screen ~ Discount Code screen is displayed
Enter 'WELCOME15' and tap Apply ~ Code is accepted; 15% discount is applied to all seats
Complete the second booking ~ Booking confirmed with 15% discount on all seats
Select seats for a third event, navigate to Discount Code screen, enter 'WELCOME15' and tap Apply ~ Code is rejected; it is no longer valid after one successful use

Name: Invalid discount code shows inline error and does not block checkout
Description: Validates that entering an unrecognised discount code shows an inline error message and the guest can still proceed to payment without a valid code.
Preconditions: Guest has selected seats and is on the Discount Code screen.
Test Steps (Steps): Enter an invalid code (e.g. 'INVALID123') in the discount code input field ~ Field is populated
Tap the 'Apply' button ~ An inline error message is displayed indicating the code is invalid; the input field remains editable
Verify the 'Continue to Payment' button is still accessible ~ Button is enabled and tappable
Tap 'Continue to Payment' without a valid code ~ Navigation proceeds to the Payment screen with no discount applied
Verify the Payment screen shows the full subtotal with no discount row ~ Total equals the full seat prices with no deduction

Name: Discount code is case-insensitive
Description: Validates that discount codes are matched case-insensitively, so entering 'save10' or 'Save10' applies the same discount as 'SAVE10'.
Preconditions: Guest has selected Standard seats and is on the Discount Code screen.
Test Steps (Steps): Enter 'save10' (all lowercase) in the discount code input and tap Apply ~ Code is accepted and 10% discount is applied to Standard seats
Remove the code and re-enter 'Save10' (mixed case) and tap Apply ~ Code is accepted and 10% discount is applied
Verify the discount amount on the Payment screen is identical regardless of the case used ~ Discount is correctly applied in all case variations

Name: Skipping discount code proceeds directly to payment
Description: Validates that the guest can skip the Discount Code screen entirely and proceed to payment without entering any code.
Preconditions: Guest has selected seats and is on the Discount Code screen with no code entered.
Test Steps (Steps): Observe the Discount Code screen ~ 'Optional — you can skip this and continue to payment.' message is displayed
Tap 'Continue to Payment' without entering any code ~ Payment screen opens
Verify the Payment screen shows the full subtotal with no discount row ~ Total equals the full seat prices; no discount line item is present

Name: Payment screen shows correct order summary with seat details and totals
Description: Validates that the Payment screen displays every selected seat, the subtotal, any applied discount, and the correct final total before confirming payment.
Preconditions: Guest has selected seats, optionally applied a discount code, and is on the Payment screen.
Test Steps (Steps): Observe the Payment screen ~ 'Review & Pay' heading is displayed along with the event name and venue
Verify each selected seat is listed with its tier and discounted/full price ~ Each seat line item shows seat ID, tier (Standard/VIP), and correct price
Verify the Subtotal row shows the sum of full seat prices ~ Subtotal is mathematically correct
If a discount was applied, verify the Discount row shows the code name and correct deduction amount ~ Discount row is present and amount is correct
Verify the Total row shows the final amount after any discount ~ Total = Subtotal − Discount
Verify the mock payment notice is displayed ~ 'This is a mock payment. No card details are collected.' message is visible
Verify the 'Pay Now' button is present and enabled ~ Button is tappable

Name: Completing payment shows booking confirmation with all details
Description: Validates that tapping Pay Now finalises the booking and displays a Confirmation screen with a unique confirmation number, event details, seat breakdown, and final price paid.
Preconditions: Guest is on the Payment screen with seats selected and order summary reviewed.
Test Steps (Steps): Tap the 'Pay Now' button ~ A processing indicator is briefly shown
Wait for the Confirmation screen to appear ~ Screen title changes to 'Confirmation'; a checkmark icon and 'Booking Confirmed' heading are displayed
Verify a unique confirmation number is shown (e.g. BK-XXXXXX) ~ Confirmation number is present and non-empty
Verify the event title, venue, and date/time are displayed ~ Event details match the booked event
Verify each booked seat is listed with its tier and price paid ~ Seat line items match the Payment screen
If a discount was applied, verify 'Discount applied: <CODE>' is shown ~ Discount code label is present
Verify 'View My Bookings' and 'Back to Events' buttons are present ~ Both navigation options are available

Name: Booked seats are no longer available for selection by the same session
Description: Validates that seats confirmed in a completed booking are marked as booked and cannot be selected again in a subsequent booking for the same event.
Preconditions: Guest has completed a booking for an event and is back on the Event List screen.
Test Steps (Steps): Navigate back to the same event that was just booked ~ Event Details screen opens
Tap 'Select a Seat' ~ Seat Selection screen opens
Verify the previously booked seats are now shown in the 'Booked' state ~ Booked seats are visually distinct and not selectable
Attempt to tap a booked seat ~ Seat cannot be selected; state remains 'booked'
Verify remaining available seats can still be selected ~ Other available seats respond to taps normally

Name: My Bookings lists all session bookings most-recent first
Description: Validates that the My Bookings screen shows all bookings made in the current session in reverse-chronological order, each with event, seats, total price, and confirmation number.
Preconditions: Guest has completed at least two bookings in the current session.
Test Steps (Steps): Tap 'My Bookings' from the Event List header or 'View My Bookings' from the Confirmation screen ~ My Bookings screen opens
Verify the most recently completed booking appears at the top of the list ~ Most recent booking is first
Verify each booking entry shows the event title, total price, venue, date/time, seat count, individual seat details, and confirmation number ~ All required fields are present for each booking
Verify the number of entries matches the number of bookings completed in the session ~ No bookings are missing or duplicated

Name: My Bookings is empty before any booking is made
Description: Validates that the My Bookings screen shows an appropriate empty state when no bookings have been made in the current session.
Preconditions: Guest has just entered the app via 'Continue as Guest' and has not completed any booking.
Test Steps (Steps): Tap the 'My Bookings' button in the Event List header ~ My Bookings screen opens
Verify no booking entries are displayed ~ An empty state message or illustration is shown indicating no bookings yet
Verify the screen does not crash or show an error ~ Screen renders gracefully with an appropriate empty state

Name: Full end-to-end booking flow without discount code
Description: Validates the complete happy-path booking journey: guest entry → event list → event details → seat selection → skip discount → payment → confirmation.
Preconditions: App is freshly launched on the landing screen.
Test Steps (Steps): Tap 'Continue as Guest' ~ Event List screen is displayed
Tap any available event card ~ Event Details screen opens with full event information
Tap 'Select a Seat' ~ Seat Selection screen opens
Select one or more available seats ~ Summary bar shows seat count and total price
Tap 'Continue to Discount Code' ~ Discount Code screen opens showing seat summary and subtotal
Tap 'Continue to Payment' without entering a code ~ Payment screen opens with full-price order summary
Tap 'Pay Now' ~ Processing indicator appears briefly, then Confirmation screen is shown
Verify confirmation number, event details, seat details, and total price are all correct ~ All booking details match what was selected

Name: Full end-to-end booking flow with valid discount code SAVE10
Description: Validates the complete booking journey with a valid SAVE10 discount code applied, verifying the discount is correctly reflected through the payment and confirmation screens.
Preconditions: App is freshly launched. Guest enters via 'Continue as Guest'. An event with Standard seats is available.
Test Steps (Steps): Tap 'Continue as Guest' and select an event with Standard seats ~ Event Details screen opens
Tap 'Select a Seat', select two Standard seats, tap 'Continue to Discount Code' ~ Discount Code screen shows 2 seats and subtotal
Enter 'SAVE10' and tap Apply ~ Discount-applied label appears with a Remove option
Tap 'Continue to Payment' ~ Payment screen shows each Standard seat at 10% off, discount row with correct deduction, and correct total
Tap 'Pay Now' ~ Confirmation screen appears
Verify confirmation shows 'Discount applied: SAVE10' and the discounted seat prices ~ Discount is correctly reflected on the confirmation screen
Tap 'View My Bookings' ~ My Bookings screen shows the booking with the discounted total

Name: Back navigation works correctly throughout the booking flow
Description: Validates that the back/navigate-up button on each screen returns the guest to the previous screen without losing context.
Preconditions: Guest is on the Event List screen.
Test Steps (Steps): Tap an event card to open Event Details ~ Event Details screen opens
Tap the back button ~ Returns to Event List screen
Tap the same event, tap 'Select a Seat', select a seat, tap 'Continue to Discount Code' ~ Discount Code screen opens
Tap the back button ~ Returns to Seat Selection screen with previously selected seat still selected
Tap 'Continue to Discount Code' again, then tap 'Continue to Payment' ~ Payment screen opens
Tap the back button ~ Returns to Discount Code screen
Tap 'Continue to Payment' again ~ Payment screen opens with the same order summary
